LanguageData.AyameICCT_ModDescription: Produce food-grade polypropylene granules and sheets to Interstellar Cha Chaan Teng standards, and package prepared food into packaged survival meals. Includes plastic conversion and engineering-plastic component recipes.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_IncludeNutrientPasteTip: Allow nutrient paste meals as ingredients in the three food-packaging recipes.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_IncludeKibbleTip: Allow kibble as an ingredient in the three food-packaging recipes.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_AllowRepackagingTip: ...Are you really sure you want to enable this? lol
LanguageData.AyameICCT_PreparedIngredientsAny: Experimental: packaged meals with prepared ingredients count as any food kind
LanguageData.AyameICCT_PreparedIngredientsAnyTip: Off by default. Packaged survival meals only: generic prepared meals and C-rations used as ingredients make the product acceptable for everyone rather than incorrectly vegetarian. Explicit vegetarian/meat meals retain their declared kind. Other foods, including paste made from paste or simple meals made from paste, are unchanged. Independent of mood inheritance.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_InheritIngredientMood: Experimental: packaged meals inherit ingredient mood
LanguageData.AyameICCT_InheritIngredientMoodTip: Off by default. Eating a packaged survival meal grants native food mood memories for one serving of each recorded direct prepared ingredient, respecting Ascetic, ideology and vanilla thought replacement. No nested ingredients or ingestion effects; other foods and food-choice previews are unchanged. Paste made from paste has no extra penalty; paste made from lavish meals gains no lavish-meal bonus.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_FoodRules: Packable foods are discovered automatically from all loaded item definitions: edible, nutritious prepared products, including meals, pemmican, baby food and nutritious drinks. Raw ingredients and corpses are excluded; packaged survival meals cannot be repackaged by default. The Dead Man's Switch C-rations count as 2.0 nutrition each for packaging only.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_FilterChanges: Settings update the packaging recipes immediately. Existing bills retain their ingredient choices; enable newly available foods in the bill's ingredient filter, or create a new bill.
